runtime_repair_equivalence.method: Rehash every completed source and record. Retain only pages with zero source image occurrences and zero raw/final IMAGE entities, where changed media behavior is unreachable. Reconvert every media-containing page, regardless of whether its previous validation passed. historical_full_corpus.stop_reason: User requested stopping the expensive full conversion after sufficient coverage; in-flight pages drained normally.

limitations: Historical corpus coverage is partial: further dispatch was stopped at the user request and in-flight tasks drained normally.
Known-font fixtures are not a representative benchmark for arbitrary fonts.
Full-corpus conversion coverage is not a ground-truth text-recognition accuracy score.
Unconfirmed scale, paper-space output and dimension-error failures remain explicit; no engineering dimensions are guessed.
Legacy v1/v2 catalogs do not provide layout metrics.
Five PyMuPDF SWIG deprecation warnings remain; they are not Ruff findings.

known_font_final_runtime_execution.method: All 100 original font PDFs were reconverted after installing the final clipping repair. The installed runtime remained frozen for every conversion and the subsequent original-font coordinate audit; source/installed bytes and all saved DXF hashes were rechecked afterwards.

fixes: Preserve the sole alpha channel of NULL-colorspace soft masks.
Use actual resampled PNG pixel dimensions in IMAGE/IMAGEDEF and pixel clipping transforms.
Bind native PDF paint order to nested clip scope, with rotation and empty clips preserved.
Report unsupported clipping as SOURCE_GRAPHICS_INCOMPLETE rather than accepting unverified visible geometry.
limitations: Soft-mask alpha remains in PNG pixels; vector clipping is preserved separately in the DXF IMAGE boundary.
Retained no-media pages were converted earlier in this turn, not reconverted with the final binary. Their source/image absence, record SHA and actual runtime identity were verified.
